model.cluster_size_caveat: Absolute outbreak sizes assume homogeneous mixing within a reachable susceptible cluster and are illustrative pending calibration to observed sizes; P(R_local>1) and P(large_outbreak) are the robust quantities.

national_importation_pressure.note: Coarse annual importation-pressure proxy: WHO European Region measles activity relative to baseline. Wide band reflects weak Europe->UK identification. Not a weekly forecast (see PLAN.md).

joint_cooccurrence.note: Shared national importation latent -> correlated per-UTLA outbreaks. Meaningful outputs are the co-occurrence BREADTH (UTLAs lighting up together) and RELATIVE tail fatness. Absolute case counts are NOT reported: the pure branching process has no susceptible depletion, so it is uncalibrated in magnitude (see PLAN.md).
